| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| a. Segment with the highest Q3 net sales | enterprise, ₩306,373,324 (consumer ₩304,006,895, smb ₩257,525,526) |
| b. Customers with a paid order in Q3 | 244 people (accounts sharing an email counted once) |

| e. Customer with the largest Q3 refund total | u12@ex.com (₩3,473,500) |

| h. Net sales growth, September vs. August | −14.6% (₩294,514,552 → ₩251,541,908) |

**About a:**
- **Which segment to use:** 37 emails are shared by accounts with different segments, and you didn't say which segment such a person belongs to. I used the segment of the account that placed each order.
- **Close margin:** enterprise leads consumer by only about ₩2.37M.
- **Alternative method:** if each email took the segment of its earliest-joined account instead, enterprise would still be first, but at ₩318,006,022.

**Other assumptions:**
- **Refund timing:** refunds have no date of their own, so each refund counts in the month of its original order.
- **Data check:** order statuses had no case variants, and every refund matched an order line and was at most the quantity ordered.
